summary: Iteration 2: Re-tested IELTS Mock Exam after admin panel + improved scoring + section instruction audio updates. 22/22 backend pytest tests passed (added 7 new tests for /api/admin/exams, /api/admin/stats, DELETE admin/exams, instruction_audio_id presence/fetchability, and case-insensitive listening scoring). Frontend e2e validated: Landing (framer-motion sections render), Dashboard (4 progress cards + exam card + admin link), Admin page (stats: 1 exam / 65 audio files / 2 users / 10 attempts; exam row with regenerate+delete), Listening preparation -> in-progress (timer ticking, 4 section tabs, play button toggles paused state, question navigator 1-10, input accepts text), Reading preparation page renders. Section instruction audio is generated and stored (instruction_audio_id present, audio fetchable as audio/mpeg).

issues: Top nav uses dark background while body uses light bg-[--ps-ice]; consistent with PRD's mixed theme but admin page has no clear page title heading inside content area (only nav text). Minor.
Carry-over from iteration 1: PRD specifies 'PlayStation-inspired LIGHT MODE' but landing hero, exam header, and admin nav still use dark bg. Decision needed for theme consistency.

action_items: OPTIONAL: align entire UI to LIGHT MODE per PRD; landing hero, exam page header, and admin nav still dark.

NOTE: review_request mentions normalize_answer() / answers_match() helper functions but server.py uses inline .strip().lower() + '|' split inside score_objective(). Functionality is equivalent and case-insensitive scoring + variation matching VERIFIED working (test_case_insensitive_and_variations passes with mixed-case answers). Consider extracting helpers for clarity (matches the documented intent).
Consider gating /api/admin/* endpoints behind an is_admin role check; currently any authenticated user can list/delete exams and trigger expensive audio regeneration.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints have NO authorization beyond authentication - any logged-in user can DELETE exams and call regenerate-audio (which is expensive). Add role check (e.g., user.is_admin or env-allowlisted emails).
/api/exams/{exam_id}/full still leaks correct_answer fields without auth (carry-over from iteration 1).
score_objective() still inline (no normalize_answer/answers_match helpers as described in change list) - works but doesn't match documented intent.
server.py is now ~1023 lines with seed/auth/scoring/audio/admin all in one file - increasingly violates 700-line guideline; modularization recommended.
admin_delete_exam returns deleted:True even when exam_id doesn't exist (no 404). Acceptable as idempotent but inconsistent with REST conventions.
Audio still base64-stored in MongoDB (65 files for one exam) - no GridFS migration; fine for MVP scale.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of attempted flows: landing, dashboard, admin, listening prep+in-progress, reading prep
